name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  August 13, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Council Community
Room “A” 1st Floor, on August 27, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Angel Leon - Martell, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Victoria Ojeda, Public Works Department
  Crystal McGlover, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Produced by 360 on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host the Hispanic Heritage
  Festival Event on Market Street between Regent and Manchester, Public Property,
  on Saturday, September 19, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Approval for a one
  (1) day event on Market Street between Florence and Manchester. Subject to Public
  Works Approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant is responsible for crowd
  control, event clean-up, and all applicable mitigation measures. Inglewood Police
  Department will provide one (1) Lieutenant, one (1) Sergeant, and ten (10) officers for
  public safety and eighteen (18) TCO’s for traffic safety – street closures. Applicant to
  request that Meridian Barriers be deployed by the Public Works Department; maintain
  the site at all times, ensuring it is properly cleaned immediately upon the end of the
  event. Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines
  set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. No Code Enforcement conditions;
  No additional recommendations needed for Fire approval. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No.135979).
 Item #2:  Bridgette Peyton, on behalf of Raiders Nation South Los Angeles, to host the
  RNSLA Friends & Family Picnic Event at 700 Warren Ln. Edward Vincent Jr. Park,
  City Park, on Sunday, September 20, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Approval
  for a 1-day event at Edward Vincent Jr. Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for
  use of the park. Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to
  all applicable IMC regulations. Deploy one (1) Police Sergeant, eight (8) Police Officers,
  and four (4) Traffic Control Officers (TCOs) to provide public safety and manage vehicle
  ingress and egress; Attendance shall not exceed the approved capacity of eighty-four
  (84) persons. If attendance exceeds the approved limit or creates a public safety
  concern, the event may be suspended or terminated at the discretion of the Inglewood
  Police Department; the applicant shall provide a minimum of ten (10) licensed security
  guards to assist with any potential crowd control. One (1) male and one (1) female
  security guard team shall be assigned to the park restrooms being used by attendees to
  deter any outside lewd conduct or unlawful activity; Alcoholic beverages, cannabis,
  illegal narcotics, glass containers, fireworks, pyrotechnics, and drone operations
  (unmanned aircraft systems) are strictly prohibited. Firearms and other dangerous
  weapons are also strictly prohibited. Provided the event concludes without significant
  incidents or violations, the Inglewood Police Department will reevaluate staffing
  recommendations for future events, potentially reducing City service costs. The applicant
  and attendees shall comply with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Applicant
  must pay the Police staff fees of $ 7,079.67 and the Parks and Recreation fees of
  $1,048.70 by September 10, 2026, not later than 4:00 p.m. Conditions for amplified
  sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct
  point of contact for the person responsible for sound and acoustic volume control. No
  recommendations needed for Fire approval. Maintain the site at all times, ensuring it is
  properly cleaned immediately after the event. Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face
  mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA
  State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.0292075).

Item #3:  Ricardo Zuniga on behalf of SteaksLA and City of Inglewood to host the Monthly
  Food Giveaway Event at 739 E. Hyde Park Blvd # 2507, Private Property, from
  Friday, September 25, 2026, from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. Friday, October 30, 2026,
  from 8:00 a.m to 10:00 a.m. November 226 / December 2026 TBD by the City of
  Inglewood Administration Department; Event continues through 2027, on Fridays of
  every month for seven months, from Friday, January 29, 2027, to Friday, July 30,
  2027. Approval for a multi-day event within a private parking lot. Applicant is responsible
  for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable mitigation measures. Applicant shall
  staff this event with a minimum of two (2) TCO’s for traffic control on each event
  day. In addition, the applicant shall staff this event with ten (10) staff members to
  ensure attendee safety and assist TCOs with traffic flow. All staff members shall
  wear reflective vests to be readily identifiable to attendees or the general public.
   There shall be NO vehicular movement in the area of pedestrians, and a vehicle
  barrier or support barrier shall be in place at the driveway/parking lot entrance. The
  IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol and high visibility will be
  provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws. Public Works
  approved it with conditions: The event should not block any portion of Hyde Park
  Blvd. or North Park Avenue. Visibility Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise
  reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact for the
  person responsible for sound and acoustic volume control. Maintain the site at all times,
  ensuring it is cleaned properly immediately upon the end of the event. Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, personal
  protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO.
  Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.0277693).

New Business License Request (s):
Item #4:  Leticia Perez on behalf of Studio DPS Cuts & Nails to operate as a Hair/ Nail Salon
  at 8005 S. Van Ness APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees;
  Business owner must possess and maintain a valid and current Establishment
  License from the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's,
  Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the establishment must
  possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating
  within the establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City;
  Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and
  copies of applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating
  within the establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages,
  narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises;
  Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; Subject to random
  inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at any time
  to ensure compliance; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Failure to comply with any of
  the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and
  any future business license application requests.(Customer No. 0292114)
